title: TSMC Q3 2025 Net Income Up 39.1%
body: TSMC announced on October 16, 2025 that Q3 2025 net income was NT$452.30 billion (about US$15.6B), up 39.1% year-on-year, supported by strong demand for leading-edge process technologies.

context.text: Taiwanese chipmaker TSMC sees nearly 40 jump in net profit thanks to AI boom
why: TSMC posted a record $15B Q3 profit up 40% YoY, confirming AI-led earnings inflection on the five-year chart.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC applies for 1.4nm Taichung A14 fab
body: TSMC submitted an application to the Central Taiwan Science Park Bureau on Friday October 17, 2025 to build its A14 (1.4nm) fab in Taichung with an initial investment of about NT$1.5 trillion (US$49 billion) and mass production targeted for the second half of 2028.

context.text: TSMC applies to build 1.4nm process fab in Taichung - Taiwan News
why: TSMC committed $49B to a 1.4nm fab, materially extending its advanced-node roadmap and capital plans.
date evidence (day)

title: US Grants TSMC Annual Nanjing Tool License
body: The U.S. Commerce Department granted TSMC Nanjing a one-year export license allowing U.S. export-controlled chipmaking items to be supplied without individual vendor licenses, ensuring uninterrupted operations and product deliveries.

context.text: U.S. grants TSMC annual licence to import U.S. chipmaking tools into China
why: The U.S. granted an annual license for China tool imports, securing TSMC's Nanjing mature-node operations.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC sets 2026 capex at $52B–$56B
body: TSMC announced on January 15, 2026 it plans 2026 capital spending of $52 billion to $56 billion, up from $40.9 billion in 2025, to meet AI demand.

context.text: US and Taiwan sign $250B trade deal, cutting tariffs on Taiwanese goods
why: TSMC raised 2026 capex to $52B–$56B, signaling a major capacity expansion driven by booming AI demand.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Q4 2025 Revenue NT$1.046 Trillion
body: TSMC announced Q4 2025 consolidated revenue of NT$1,046.09 billion, up 20.5% year-over-year, driven by strong AI-related demand for leading-edge process technologies.

context.text: Taiwan Semiconductor Q4 Revenue Jumps 20%, Tops Forecasts
why: Q4 2025 revenue of T$1.046 trillion beat forecasts, confirming accelerating AI-driven growth into year-end.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC to produce 3nm chips in Japan
body: TSMC announced on February 5, 2026 it will make 3-nanometer chips in Kumamoto with planned investment of ¥2.6 trillion ($17 billion) and Japanese government support.

context.text: TSMC Plans $17 Billion Japan Expansion With Advanced 3nm Chips As Tokyo Ramps Up Subsidies - Apple  ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) , NVIDIA  ( NASDAQ:NVDA )
why: A $17B Japan 3nm expansion shifts Kumamoto to advanced nodes, broadening TSMC's geographic advanced capacity.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Q1 2026 net profit up 58% to record
body: TSMC announced on April 16, 2026 that Q1 2026 net income rose 58.3% year-over-year to NT$572.48 billion, a record, supported by strong AI-driven demand for leading-edge process technologies.

context.text: TSMC Q1 profit jumps 58% to record, beats expectations
why: TSMC posted a record Q1 2026 net profit up 58% on AI demand, confirming accelerated earnings growth.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC debuts A13, previews A12 and CoWoS expansion
body: TSMC announced A13 and A12 process nodes for 2029 production alongside CoWoS expansion to 14 reticles in 2028 and co-packaged optics production in 2026.

context.text: TSMC’s next-generation chip coming in 2029
why: TSMC unveiled its next-generation A13/A12 nodes and major CoWoS expansion, defining its 2029 technology and packaging roadmap.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC exits Arm with $231M share sale
body: TSMC's subsidiary TSMC Partners sold 1,110,784 Arm shares at $207.65 each for about $231 million, fully divesting its Arm stake on April 28-29, 2026.

context.text: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing exits Arm Holdings with $231M share sale
why: TSMC fully divested its $231M Arm stake, marking a notable portfolio cleanup and capital reallocation.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC approves $31.28B capex for expansion
body: TSMC's board approved capital appropriations of approximately US$31,284.30 million mainly for advanced technology capacity and fab construction.

context.text: Taiwan Semiconductor Sees Global Chip Market Hitting $1.5 Trillion By 2030 Amid AI Boom - Taiwan Semicond
why: Board-approved $31.28B capex authorizes nine new fab stages, materially expanding TSMC's advanced manufacturing and packaging capacity.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC approves $20B Arizona capital injection
body: TSMC's board approved a capital injection of not more than US$20 billion to TSMC Arizona, a wholly-owned subsidiary, on May 12, 2026.

context.text: Buy TSM Below $400
why: Raising 2026 revenue outlook to over 30% and injecting $20B into Arizona signals a major upward revision in growth and US expansion.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC and Amkor sign 10-year packaging deal
body: TSMC and Amkor announced a 10-year agreement for TSMC to procure advanced packaging and testing services from Amkor in Arizona.

context.text: Amkor Technology Inc Stock (AMKR) Moved Up by 7.42% on Jun 16: Key Drivers Unveiled
why: A 10-year Amkor packaging deal secures advanced packaging capacity and extends TSMC's Arizona supply chain integration.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC Q2 2026 Net Income Up 77.4% YoY
body: TSMC announced on July 16, 2026 that its Q2 2026 net income was NT$706.56 billion, up 77.4% year-over-year, with revenue of NT$1,270.38 billion.

context.text: Here Is the 1 Dirt-Cheap Semiconductor Titan I Keep Loading Up on Repeat
why: Record Q2 2026 results with 43.82% net income growth confirm sustained AI-driven profitability momentum.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC raises 2026 capex to $60B-$64B
body: TSMC announced on July 16, 2026 it raised its 2026 capital expenditure forecast to $60 billion–$64 billion from $52 billion–$56 billion due to strong AI and HPC demand.

context.text: Why AMD Stock Is Falling Premarket Today Despite Fresh Price Target Hikes
why: TSMC raised 2026 capex guidance to $60B–$64B, signaling stronger AI-driven capacity build-out than previously planned.
date evidence (day)

title: TSMC and Sony Sign JV for Image Sensors
body: TSMC and Sony signed a definitive agreement to establish Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation in Kumamoto, with TSMC investing 282 billion yen and volume production targeted for 2029.

context.text: TSMC & Sony Establish JV in Japan to Develop Smartphone Image Sensors
why: Established a large Japan image-sensor joint venture with Sony, diversifying TSMC's product base and geographic manufacturing.
date evidence (day)
